caption: The drawing consists of a primary large rectangular textile design in blue and off-white, and a smaller sample of the "reverse side" positioned below it. The main section features a border with stylized blue trees along the lower edge and left side, separated by fence-like elements. In the bottom left corner, there is a blue lion facing left above which is the text "MARIA TRACY 1840." Along the left edge, the words "JEFFERSON CO. NY" are repeated vertically in blue. Inside the border, the interior is decorated with a central circular floral motif and surrounded by blue eight-pointed stars and smaller circular flower shapes on a white background. A variety of stylized leaf and floral forms fill the spaces between the central motif and the border. The color scheme is dominated by blue for all pictorial and text elements on an off-white or light background. The notation “7 5/8" ACTUAL LENGTH 6 9/16" ACTUAL WIDTH” is inscribed to the left of the smaller sample, which itself shows the reverse side of the textile with a similar arrangement of stars and a larger flower pattern, but colors are inverted with blue as the background and white for the stars and floral elements. At the bottom left of the design is the name "R. ELVIS," and beneath the sample, it is labeled "REVERSE SIDE."
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
